verses.text: Praise the LORD! I will thank the LORD with all my heart, in the meeting of honest people and in the gathering of his people.
The things the LORD does are great. All who enjoy them think deeply about them.
What he does is full of glory and majesty. His goodness lasts forever.
He has made his amazing works unforgettable. The LORD is kind and full of mercy.
He gives food to those who respect him. He always remembers his covenant.
He has shown his people the power of his works by giving them the lands of other nations.
Everything he does is faithful and fair. All his commands can be trusted.
They stand firm forever and ever. They were given in truth and honesty.
He sent rescue to his people. He set up his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Respect for the LORD is where wisdom begins. All who follow his commands have good understanding. His praise lasts forever!
